title: symphyotrichum lateriflorum
intro: Symphyotrichum lateriflorum, commonly known as the Greene's Wood's Aster or White Wood Aster, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum lateriflorum include its use in traditional medicine for treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
